content: pgvector python package v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-06, pypi verified) supports SQLAlchemy, SQLModel, Psycopg3, asyncpg, pg8000. Async SQLAlchemy setup uses postgresql+asyncpg:// URL; async connections need register_vector_async via engine event listener since asyncpg has no auto-adapter registration like psycopg2.
